title: Akustikhane Across the Documentary
synopsis: Akustikhane Across is a cross-cultural music documentary series that brings together visionary artists from different disciplines to create unique collaborative performances. Blending traditional instruments, electronic sounds, and improvisational dialogue, the series captures the intimate creative process as musicians explore each other's worlds and craft once-in-a-lifetime sessions. Created by Emirhan Celikbilek (Emiran), the series curates musicians, venues, and sonic atmospheres into a living cultural archive, documenting the journey across genres and the unifying power of artistic collaboration. Season 1 introduces the experimental journey with bold pairings: Safak Ozkutle (Oceanvs Orientalis) and Ismail Tuncbilek, merging Anatolian melodies with electronic textures. Emirhan Celikbilek (Emiran) and Izzet Kizil, weaving deep electronic beats with percussive mastery. Islandman and Muhlis Berberoglu, fusing psychedelic soundscapes with traditional strings. Ikaru and Baris Demirel, blending atmospheric electronica with brass improvisation. Season 2 expands the dialogue, featuring new voices and directions: Mercan Dede and Chromas, a spiritual electronic-choral collaboration. Cem Yildiz and Eylem Pelit, exploring Anatolian folk roots with modern arrangements. Kahadir Bartal and Kerem Demirayak (Karakter), pushing the boundaries of electronic composition. Serkan Emre Ciftci and Demir Yurdabak (Ceaus), bridging trumpet and experimental production. Through intimate sessions and cinematic storytelling, Akustikhane Across documents the transformative power of collaboration, showing how music transcends genres, geographies, and generations.
